text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New government of 14 ministers to take oath and assume duties on Wednesday.
- Kuwait Investment Company completes long-planned merger with Kuwait Foreign Trade, Contracting and Investment Company.
- Kuwait National Petroleum Company reduces lead levels in fuel on local market.
- Kuwait Investment Authority plans to sell most of its stake in Kuwait Real Estate Bank.
- U.N. body in charge of compensation for the 1990-91 Gulf crisis victims pushes for the oil-for-food deal with Iraq.
